description: Bruggen/Civiele kunstwerkonderdelen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by DONL Dataregister. Locatie en gegevens over de (civieltechnische) kunstwerkonderdelen in de openbare ruimte van Hollands Kroon. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher DONL Dataregister. Its tags are Bruggen, brug, civiel, hollands kroon, openbare ruimte. It offers 7 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP. The portal shows 2022-02-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
